about_the_game:
Traffic in OMSI 2 is getting a major upgrade – and we mean that quite literally!

For the first time ever, AI vehicles with trailers are joining the streets with Downloadpack Vol. 15, bringing fresh variety and new possibilities to your maps.

From nimble cars with small cargo trailers, rugged SUVs towing horse or boat trailers, and spacious camper combos to versatile transport vans – this pack delivers a rich mix of vehicle types that will make your virtual cityscapes feel even more dynamic and realistic.

A special highlight is the highly detailed crane truck, available both as an AI vehicle and as a static object in two different positions, a real eye-catcher for construction sites and industrial zones.

All vehicles and trailers come in various color schemes and feature semi-fictional company logos, helping to create believable urban traffic scenarios full of character.

Creative minds can go even further: with the included repaint templates, you can design your own liveries and customize the city streets to your liking.

More variety, more life! This Downloadpack takes OMSI’s AI traffic to the next level.

Please note: AI vehicles must be manually added to your maps (OMSI does not place them automatically). A setup guide is included with the pack.

Features:

  • Wide range of vehicles: cars, SUVs, vans, platform lorry and motorhomes

  • Various trailers: tarp trailers, horse and boat trailers, box trailers, car trailers, and caravans

  • Impressive crane truck: available as a driving AI vehicle and as static objects in multiple configurations

  • Numerous repaints with fictional company logos

  • Repaint templates for creating your own designs

  • Static models for map construction

  • Authentic sound effects for a realistic audio atmosphere

Please note: Long vehicle-trailer combinations may cause issues on narrow maps or tight curves. For tighter turns, consider using shorter vehicles.
